title: Continuous Life
subtitle: SmoothLife Multi-Kernel Continuous Automata
description: Generalization of Conway's Game of Life to continuous floating-point state space, exhibiting fluid-like organic self-replicating solitons.
mathNotation: s^{t+\Delta t}(x,y) = \sigma\left( s^t(x,y), \iint K_{\text{outer}}(r) s^t(\mathbf{x}+\mathbf{r}) d\mathbf{r}, \iint K_{\text{inner}}(r) s^t(\mathbf{x}+\mathbf{r}) d\mathbf{r} \right)
